definitions.explanation: A private house where rooms are rented, often with meals provided.
The act of staying at such accommodation.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}の{時|とき}、{下宿|げしゅく}に{住|す}んでいた。
examples.english: When I was a student, I lived in a boarding house.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{近|ちか}くで{下宿|げしゅく}している。

notes: {下宿|げしゅく}する means to board or lodge. Traditional Japanese boarding houses often provided meals. Less common now as apartments have become more prevalent.
